steps.title: In a browser
steps.note: Starts the local relay on ws://127.0.0.1:8791, then Vite on http://localhost:5180. Logs in logs/dev.log, stop with ./stop.sh.

steps.title: As a desktop app
steps.note: Same relay, in a Tauri window. On Nvidia with Wayland it switches the renderer and falls back to XWayland by itself.

steps.title: Build for production
steps.note: Type-check and bundle to dist, about 2 MB. bun run tauri:build produces the desktop binary.

steps.title: Host your own relay
steps.note: Bun, one port, no database. Point the app at it with VITE_RELAY_URL, or pick it in Settings at runtime.
